subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to discover and claim ClawHub promotional model offers

question: Should ClawHub promotional model activation land as a new core `openclaw promos` command group via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100236, or should it be narrowed into an existing models/configure/plugin surface?
rationale: This adds a new core CLI surface that consumes remote ClawHub payloads and mutates provider auth/model configuration; VISION.md supports CLI/provider ergonomics but also asks core to stay lean when plugin paths suffice.

options.title: Review Linked Core PR
options.body: Treat the dedicated `openclaw promos` command group as the intended direction and review the linked PR for payload, auth, config, docs, and proof quality.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Models Flow
options.body: Ask the implementation to expose promotions through `openclaw models` or `configure` instead of adding a new root command group.

options.title: Defer Core Surface
options.body: Leave promotion claim flows outside core until ClawHub/plugin APIs prove a self-serve path is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Review Linked Core PR
recommendation.body: Treat the dedicated `openclaw promos` command group as the intended direction and review the linked PR for payload, auth, config, docs, and proof quality.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the issue and the linked implementation PR that embodies the product choice.
